body.id: Integritas: berbuat benar juga saat tidak ada yang melihat.
body.en: Integrity: doing the right thing even when no one is watching.

body.id: Di tempat kerja, itu berarti jujur soal waktu, uang, data, dan kesalahan.
body.en: At work, that means honesty about time, money, data and mistakes.

body.id: Adil tidak selalu sama rata: kadang sesuai giliran, kadang sesuai kebutuhan, selalu dengan aturan yang jelas.
body.en: Fair isn't always equal: sometimes by turn, sometimes by need, always with clear rules.

body.id: Empati: berusaha memahami perasaan orang lain sebelum menilai.
body.en: Empathy: trying to understand how others feel before judging.

body.id: Emosi itu wajar. Yang bisa kita atur adalah tindakan kita saat merasakannya.
body.en: Emotions are normal. What we can manage is what we do while feeling them.

body.id: Cara sederhana: tarik napas pelan, namai perasaannya, lalu pilih tanggapan.
body.en: A simple method: breathe slowly, name the feeling, then choose your response.

caption.id: Sari memeriksa laporan penjualan buatan Dimas sebelum dikirim ke atasan.
caption.en: Sari was checking Dimas's sales report before it went to their manager.

caption.id: Ada angka yang terhitung dua kali. Target tim jadi tampak tercapai.
caption.en: One figure had been counted twice. It made the team look as if it had hit its target.

caption.id: Sari mengajak Dimas bicara berdua dan menunjukkan angkanya dengan tenang.
caption.en: Sari asked Dimas for a quiet word and calmly showed him the figure.

caption.id: Dimas memperbaikinya dan memberi tahu atasan sendiri. Atasan berterima kasih karena tahu lebih awal.
caption.en: Dimas corrected it and told the manager himself. The manager was grateful to know early.

caption.id: Seorang pelanggan membentak Rina karena pesanannya salah.
caption.en: A customer snapped at Rina because his order was wrong.

caption.id: Rina menarik napas pelan dua kali sebelum menjawab.
caption.en: Rina took two slow breaths before answering.

caption.id: «Saya mengerti Bapak kesal, saya ganti sekarang,» kata Rina. Pelanggan itu mulai tenang.
caption.en: "I understand you're upset, sir — I'll replace it now," said Rina. The customer began to calm down.

caption.id: Saat istirahat, Rina bercerita kepada rekannya. Menceritakan perasaannya membuatnya lebih lega.
caption.en: On her break, Rina told a colleague about it. Putting her feelings into words helped her feel lighter.

model_answer.id: Sari bicara dulu dengan Dimas; Dimas memperbaiki laporannya dan memberi tahu atasan sendiri.
model_answer.en: Sari spoke to Dimas first; he corrected the report and told the manager himself.

meaning.id: Bagaimana jika Dimas menolak memperbaikinya?
meaning.en: What if Dimas had refused to correct it?

text.id: Diam saja, toh bukan laporan Sari
text.en: Say nothing — it isn't Sari's report

text.id: Sampaikan ke atasan dengan fakta, tanpa menjelekkan Dimas
text.en: Raise it with the manager, sticking to the facts and not running Dimas down

text.id: Ceritakan ke rekan lain agar Dimas malu
text.en: Tell other colleagues so Dimas is embarrassed

model_answer.id: Data yang salah bisa menyesatkan keputusan tim. Menyampaikan fakta kepada yang berwenang menjaga integritas; mempermalukan Dimas tidak memperbaiki apa pun.
model_answer.en: Wrong data can mislead the team's decisions. Taking the facts to the right person protects integrity; shaming Dimas fixes nothing.

meaning.id: Pasangkan urusan kerja dengan sikap berintegritas.
meaning.en: Match each part of work with the honest practice.

text.en: Claim only what the real receipts show

text.id: Isi absen sesuai jam datang sebenarnya
text.en: Clock in at the time you actually arrive

text.id: Laporkan apa adanya, termasuk yang buruk
text.en: Report them as they are, including the bad ones

model_answer.id: Uang, waktu, dan data: tiga tempat integritas paling sering diuji di kantor.
model_answer.en: Money, time and data: the three places integrity is tested most at work.

meaning.id: Saat atasan sedang cuti: mana yang berintegritas?
meaning.en: While the manager is on leave: which show integrity?

text.en: Copying a colleague's work and taking the credit

text.id: Datang siang karena tak ada yang memeriksa
text.en: Coming in late because no one's checking

text.id: Menyerahkan barang temuan ke bagian umum
text.en: Handing found items to the office
Using an inside contact to jump the queue

model_answer.id: Integritas tidak bergantung pada siapa yang mengawasi. Yang benar tetap benar saat atasan cuti.
model_answer.en: Integrity doesn't depend on who's watching. Right stays right when the boss is away.

meaning.id: Setelah perjalanan dinas, uang muka Anda bersisa Rp150.000.
meaning.en: After a work trip, you have Rp150,000 left from your cash advance.

text.en: Using it to treat the team
Holding on to it until someone asks

model_answer.id: Uang muka adalah uang kantor. Mentraktir tim terasa baik, tetapi tetap memakai uang yang bukan hak Anda.
model_answer.en: A cash advance is the company's money. Treating the team feels generous, but it still spends money that isn't yours.

meaning.id: Pasangkan gambar dan nilainya.
meaning.en: Match each picture to its value.

model_answer.id: Jujur, disiplin, kerja sama, peduli: integritas sehari-hari di tempat kerja.
model_answer.en: Honest, disciplined, cooperative, caring: everyday integrity at work.

meaning.id: Mana yang adil, mana yang kurang adil?
meaning.en: Which are fair, and which aren't?

text.id: Memberi kesempatan bicara kepada anggota baru
text.en: Giving a new member a chance to speak

text.id: Tidak mengajak rekan yang berbeda pendapat
text.en: Leaving out a colleague who disagrees

model_answer.id: Adil berarti aturan yang sama untuk semua dan kesempatan yang sama untuk didengar.
model_answer.en: Fair means the same rules for everyone and the same chance to be heard.

meaning.id: Kantor punya lima kursi ergonomis untuk 20 karyawan. Bagaimana membaginya?
meaning.en: The office has five ergonomic chairs for 20 staff. How should they be shared?

text.en: Give them to the most senior staff

text.id: Utamakan yang punya surat dokter untuk keluhan punggung, dengan aturan terbuka
text.en: Priority to staff with a doctor's note for back problems, under open rules

model_answer.id: Undian adil caranya, tetapi tidak melihat kebutuhan; senioritas tidak terkait kebutuhan. Mengutamakan yang paling membutuhkan, dengan aturan terbuka, paling adil.
model_answer.en: A draw is fair in method but ignores need; seniority has nothing to do with need. Priority by need, under open rules, is fairest.

meaning.id: Urutan menengahi dua rekan yang berselisih.
meaning.en: The steps of helping two colleagues settle a dispute.

model_answer.id: Tenangkan dulu, dengarkan keduanya, cari jalan keluar bersama, lalu sepakati.
model_answer.en: Calm things first, hear both, find a solution together, then agree on it.

meaning.id: Di rapat, satu rekan jarang mendapat kesempatan bicara.
meaning.en: In meetings, one colleague rarely gets a chance to speak.

model_answer.id: Memberi giliran bicara kepada yang jarang didengar membuat keputusan lebih adil — dan sering lebih baik.
model_answer.en: Giving the floor to someone rarely heard makes decisions fairer — and often better.

meaning.id: Pasangkan situasi dengan cara adilnya.
meaning.en: Match each situation with its fair approach.

text.en: Few seats in a waiting room
Put those in most need first

text.id: Bagi sesuai kemampuan dan beban kerja

model_answer.id: Adil punya beberapa wajah: giliran, kebutuhan, kemampuan, atau sama rata — pilih yang sesuai situasinya.
model_answer.en: Fairness has several faces: turns, need, ability or equal shares — choose the one that fits.

meaning.id: Satu kelompok mendapat semua tugas berat. Gambar mana yang menunjukkan pembagian adil?
meaning.en: One group gets all the heavy jobs. Which picture shows a fair split?

text.en: A scale tipped to the left
A scale tipped to the right

model_answer.id: Pembagian yang adil membuat beban seimbang, sesuai kemampuan tiap kelompok.
model_answer.en: A fair split balances the load, in line with each group's capacity.

meaning.id: Hadiah dari rekanan yang menunggu keputusan kontrak dari Anda boleh diterima asal nilainya kecil.
meaning.en: A gift from a supplier awaiting your contract decision is fine to accept if it's small.

model_answer.id: Hadiah dari pihak yang menunggu keputusan Anda bisa memengaruhi penilaian. Tolak dengan sopan atau laporkan sesuai aturan kantor.
model_answer.en: A gift from someone awaiting your decision can sway your judgement. Decline politely or report it under your workplace rules.

meaning.id: Adil atau kurang adil?
meaning.en: Fair or unfair?

text.en: Asking every member for their view

model_answer.id: Giliran yang sama dan suara yang sama untuk semua: itulah dasar keadilan di tim.
model_answer.en: Equal turns and an equal voice for everyone: that's the basis of fairness in a team.

meaning.id: Rekan kerja baru saja kehilangan orang tuanya.
meaning.en: A colleague has just lost a parent.

text.en: Avoiding them because it feels awkward

model_answer.id: Saat berduka, kehadiran dan telinga yang mendengar sering lebih berarti daripada nasihat.
model_answer.en: In grief, being there and listening often means more than advice.

meaning.id: Pasangkan perasaan dengan tanggapan yang berempati.
meaning.en: Match each feeling with an empathetic reply.

text.en: A colleague just got good news

text.id: «Istirahat sebentar, biar saya bantu yang ini.»
text.en: "Take a short break — let me help with this."

text.id: «Sepertinya Anda kesal. Ada yang bisa saya bantu?»
text.en: "You seem upset. Can I help with anything?"

model_answer.id: Empati dimulai dari melihat perasaan orang lain, lalu menanggapinya dengan tepat.
model_answer.en: Empathy starts with noticing someone's feelings, then responding to them well.

meaning.id: Mana yang menunjukkan empati?
meaning.en: Which show empathy?

text.id: Menertawakan musibah orang di media sosial

text.en: Leaving a new colleague to eat alone
Inviting a new colleague to join in

text.id: Memotong cerita orang yang sedang sedih

model_answer.id: Empati tampak dari tindakan: hadir, membantu, mengajak, dan tidak menertawakan kesulitan orang.
model_answer.en: Empathy shows in actions: being there, helping, including, and never laughing at someone's trouble.

meaning.id: Tetangga baru pindah dari daerah lain dan belum kenal siapa pun.
meaning.en: A new neighbour has moved from another region and knows no one.

text.en: Waiting for them to make the first move
Gossiping about them in the residents' group

model_answer.id: Pindah ke tempat baru bisa terasa sepi. Sapaan dan tawaran bantuan membuatnya merasa diterima.
model_answer.en: Moving somewhere new can be lonely. A greeting and an offer of help make them feel welcome.

meaning.id: Berempati berarti selalu menyetujui pendapat orang lain.
meaning.en: Being empathetic means always agreeing with the other person.

model_answer.id: Anda bisa memahami perasaan seseorang tanpa menyetujui pendapatnya.
model_answer.en: You can understand someone's feelings without agreeing with their view.

meaning.id: Kasir yang tampak lelah salah menghitung belanjaan Anda.
meaning.en: A tired-looking cashier gets your total wrong.

text.en: Posting a complaint with their photo

text.id: Tetap tenang dan menunjukkan kekeliruannya dengan ramah
text.en: Staying calm and kindly pointing out the error

model_answer.id: Kekeliruan kecil bisa diperbaiki dengan ramah. Teguran keras atau unggahan memperburuk hari orang yang sudah lelah.
model_answer.en: A small mistake can be fixed kindly. A telling-off or a post makes a tired person's day worse.

model_answer.id: Rina menenangkan diri, mengakui kekesalan pelanggan, memperbaiki pesanannya, lalu bercerita kepada rekan.
model_answer.en: Rina calmed herself, acknowledged the customer's frustration, fixed the order, then talked it over with a colleague.

meaning.id: Apa yang Rina lakukan sebelum menjawab pelanggan?
meaning.en: What did Rina do before answering the customer?

model_answer.id: Dua tarikan napas pelan memberi jeda, sehingga Rina bisa memilih jawaban, bukan sekadar bereaksi.
model_answer.en: Two slow breaths gave her a pause, so she could choose her reply instead of just reacting.

meaning.id: Saat marah memuncak: urutkan langkahnya.
meaning.en: When anger rises: put the steps in order.

model_answer.id: Sadari, tarik napas, baru bicara. Jeda singkat mencegah kata-kata yang nanti disesali.
model_answer.en: Notice, breathe, then talk. A short pause prevents words you'd regret.

meaning.id: Saat kesal: mana yang menenangkan, mana yang memperbesar marah?
meaning.en: When you're upset: what calms you, and what fans the anger?

text.en: Cutting in with a raised voice

model_answer.id: Napas pelan, jalan sebentar, dan minum air memberi jeda. Membalas saat panas biasanya memperbesar masalah.
model_answer.en: Slow breaths, a short walk and a glass of water give you a pause. Replying in the heat of the moment usually makes things worse.

meaning.id: Pukul 22.00, Anda membaca surel bernada kasar dari rekan kerja.
meaning.en: At 10 p.m. you read a harsh-sounding email from a colleague.

text.id: Balas malam ini juga dengan nada yang sama
text.en: Reply tonight in the same tone

text.id: Simpan draf balasan, kirim besok setelah tenang
text.en: Save a draft reply and send it tomorrow once calm

text.id: Teruskan ke seluruh tim agar mereka tahu
text.en: Forward it to the whole team so they know

model_answer.id: Membalas saat tenang membuat pesan Anda lebih jelas dan adil. Membalas dengan nada sama atau meneruskannya memperluas konflik.
model_answer.en: Replying when calm makes your message clearer and fairer. Matching the tone or forwarding it spreads the conflict.

meaning.id: Pasangkan wajah dengan nama perasaannya.
meaning.en: Match each face with the feeling's name.

model_answer.id: Menamai perasaan — senang, sedih, lelah, marah — adalah langkah pertama mengelolanya.
model_answer.en: Naming feelings — happy, sad, tired, angry — is the first step to managing them.

meaning.id: Rekan menangis setelah rapat.
meaning.en: A colleague is in tears after a meeting.

text.id: Mengajaknya ke tempat tenang dan mendengarkan
text.en: Taking them somewhere quiet and listening
Telling the group chat about it

model_answer.id: Tempat tenang dan telinga yang mendengar membantu lebih dulu; nasihat bisa menunggu sampai ia siap.
model_answer.en: A quiet place and a listening ear help first; advice can wait until they're ready.

meaning.id: Memendam semua perasaan tanpa pernah membicarakannya adalah cara terbaik mengelola emosi.
meaning.en: Bottling up every feeling and never talking about it is the best way to manage emotions.

model_answer.id: Menamai dan membicarakan perasaan dengan orang yang tepat biasanya lebih membantu daripada memendamnya.
model_answer.en: Naming feelings and talking them over with the right person usually helps more than bottling them up.

items.source: Lieberman, M. D., Eisenberger, N. I., Crockett, M. J., Tom, S. M., Pfeifer, J. H., & Way, B. M. (2007). Putting feelings into words: Affect labeling disrupts amygdala activity in response to affective stimuli. Psychological Science, 18(5), 421–428.

model_answer.id: Dalam sebuah studi pencitraan otak, orang yang menamai emosi pada foto wajah («marah», «takut») menunjukkan aktivitas amigdala yang lebih rendah. Amigdala adalah bagian otak yang berperan dalam reaksi emosi.
model_answer.en: In a brain-imaging study, people who put a name to the emotion in photos of faces ("angry", "scared") showed less activity in the amygdala, a part of the brain involved in emotional reactions.

meaning.id: Empat rekan makan bersama; tagihan Rp240.000 dibagi rata. Andi membayar semuanya dulu. Berapa rupiah total yang harus ia terima dari tiga rekannya?
meaning.en: Four colleagues eat together and split the Rp240,000 bill equally. Andi pays it all first. How much should he get back in total from the other three?
